title: signals
description: Deduplicated, entity-resolved funding rounds, acquisitions, and exec moves as MCP tools.
summary: Deduplicated, entity-resolved funding rounds, acquisitions, and exec moves as MCP tools.
offersHint: Deduplicated, entity-resolved funding rounds, acquisitions, and exec moves as MCP tools. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://api.datahyena.com/mcp

toolsPreview.name: funding_events
toolsPreview.description: List funding events ordered by announcement date, newest first. Filter by round, amount range, company HQ country, industry group, or a specific company id. Costs one credit per returned record.

toolsPreview.name: acquisitions
toolsPreview.description: List acquisition and merger events ordered by announcement date, newest first. Filter by payment type, deal amount range, merger flag, or a company that is the acquirer or target. Costs one credit per returned record.

toolsPreview.name: exec_moves
toolsPreview.description: List executive appointment, promotion, departure, and transition events ordered by announcement date, newest first. Filter by company, person, role seniority, move type, or a time window. Costs one credit per returned record.

toolsPreview.name: companies
toolsPreview.description: Search and filter company records by keyword, exact domain, HQ country, industry group, employee-count bucket, or founded-year range. Costs one credit per returned record.

toolsPreview.name: investors
toolsPreview.description: Search and filter investor records by keyword, type, HQ country, or exact domain. Costs one credit per returned record.

toolsPreview.name: company_timeline
toolsPreview.description: Return one company's timeline: firmographics, investors, and a chronological list of funding rounds, acquisitions, and executive moves. Resolve the company by id, domain, name, or LinkedIn URL. Pick event kinds with include (default all). Costs one credit for the company plus one per pulled event; nothing is charged if no company matches.

toolsPreview.name: list_watchlists
toolsPreview.description: List the workspace's account watchlists with member counts. Free.

toolsPreview.name: get_watchlist
toolsPreview.description: Return one watchlist with its resolved company members. Free.

toolsPreview.name: create_watchlist
toolsPreview.description: Create a named account watchlist. Free.

toolsPreview.name: add_to_watchlist
toolsPreview.description: Add companies (domain, name, LinkedIn URL, or id) to a watchlist. Returns a per-item result of added, already_present, or unresolved. Free.

toolsPreview.name: remove_from_watchlist
toolsPreview.description: Remove companies from a watchlist. Free.
